				Time limit for submission of claims on Tour / Transfer / Journey on retirement has been revised by Govt to sixty days from date
of completion of return journey. Please ensure submission of claims within the prescribed time limit to avoid the same being time
barred and consequent recovery of advance drawn, if any. 
 If you see change in your CDA A/c Number 
CDA A/C No. is alloted to all officers in the format NN/NNN/NNNNNNA (N stands for Number, A stands for Alphabet.) The first five digits at
the begining of this number i.e. NN/NNN are subject to CHANGE when our internal task distribution is changed in Ledger Wing. You need not
worry about such change. The last six digits along with check alpha i.e. NNNNNNA is the number which will REMAIN FIXED THROUGHOUT
THE SERVICE of an officer.
